/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in numpy
 * @description Using pickle.load or pickle.loads with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-numpy
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe deserialization using pickle.load/loads in numpy

/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec in numpy
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-numpy
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module CodeInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(CodeExecution ce).getCode()
  }
}

module CodeInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CodeInjectionConfig>;
import CodeInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CodeInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CodeInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CodeInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Code injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Check for eval/exec calls with untrusted input in numpy code

/**
 * @name Insecure temporary file usage in numpy
 * @description Using predictable temporary file names can lead to symlink attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-temp-files-numpy
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("mktemp").getACall() and
  not call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("vendored-meson/%")
select call, "Insecure temporary file creation using mktemp (predictable name)."
findings.hypothesis: Check for insecure temporary file creation using mktemp which is predictable and vulnerable to symlink attacks
